summary: A vertebrate phylogeny (Open Tree) and fossil osteichthyan occurrences (PBDB, 241,417 occurrences) are open, but no dataset coding lungs versus swim bladders per species was found, and the matrices (MorphoBank) and expression database (Bgee) named by assessors returned 403. The ancestral-state test would need a hand-compiled trait table from the anatomical literature.
next_step: Compile a per-species coding of gas-bladder type (ventral lung / dorsal bladder / none) for major osteichthyan lineages from the literature and map it on the Open Tree vertebrate subtree.
obstacles_confirmed: Soft tissue rarely fossilises; extant phylogenetic bracketing is required.
No ready lung/bladder trait table located.
